author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In this live stream excerpt, Adam Savage answers Tested member questions about the early days of MythBusters and what made the original team uniquely prepared to tackle the show. Adam reflects on working with Jamie Hyneman on sets, learning to handle stress without drama, and why focusing strictly on methodology rather than outcomes defined the series. Plus, Adam shares behind-the-scenes memories from filming the herding cats myth, including a rescue mission for a spooked cat. With thanks to telismyname and Vickie-Bligh for their support and questions!
